{{Top|leg}}
An '''Oro bark''' was a type of food that came from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Oro wood]]. It was served in sticks and often sweetened.<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

While secretly watching a party held in the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace's]] [[Grand Ballroom (Aldera Royal Palace)|Grand Ballroom]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Winter Celchu|Winter]] snacked on sweetened oro bark inside their hiding place.<ref name="hostage" />
